model_path.description: Path to the planner ONNX file. Its TensorRT engine is built and cached beside it as <stem>.engine.

plugins_path.description: TensorRT plugin library the planner graph needs; empty for none.

build_only.description: Exit after the TensorRT engines are built.

precision.description: TensorRT builder precision of the planner. With a graph that carries float16 tensors of its own, fp16 makes the builder obey the graph's per-layer types.

trt_workspace_mib.description: TensorRT builder workspace in MiB, shared by both engines: an upper bound on the builder's scratch memory, not an allocation.

shift_x.description: Use the vehicle centre instead of base_link as the model's reference point, as autoware_diffusion_planner's option of the same name.

input_timeout_seconds.description: How long the pacing sensor may stay silent before inference_status reports the wait.

dump_dir.description: Debug only: directory to write the host-side input and output tensors of the first dump_max_frames inferences to, as raw float32 files plus a JSONL manifest. Empty disables it.

translation_slack_m.description: Translation slack of the localization-jump check [m].

max_speed_mps.description: Fastest motion the check allows between two odometry samples [m/s].

yaw_slack_rad.description: Yaw slack of the localization-jump check [rad].

max_yaw_rate_rps.description: Fastest yaw rate the check allows [rad/s].

interval_tolerance_seconds.description: How far a cached map may lie from a history step's target time and still fill it [s].

substitute_max_seconds.description: How much older than its target a map may be to stand in for a dropped LiDAR frame [s]; 0 disables substitution.

warmup.description: Until the history is complete: wait, or duplicate the newest map into the missing steps.

max_delay_ms.description: Oldest point cloud the node plans on, against the node clock [ms].

max_future_skew_ms.description: How far in the future a point cloud stamp may lie [ms].

engine_path.description: Engine cache of the extractor; empty puts <onnx stem>.engine beside the ONNX file.

onnx_path.description: Path to the BEV feature extractor ONNX file.

plugins_path.description: TensorRT plugin library with the sparse-convolution operators of the extractor graph.

precision.description: TensorRT builder precision of the extractor.

cloud_capacity.description: Most points of one cloud the extractor reads; the rest are dropped.

circle_nms_dist_threshold.description: Class-agnostic circle NMS distance on the box centres [m]; 0 disables it.

iou_nms_search_distance_2d.description: Search distance of the BEV-IoU NMS [m].

iou_nms_threshold.description: BEV IoU above which the lower-scored object is dropped.

yaw_norm_thresholds.description: Per head class, in class_names order: a proposal whose (sin, cos) norm is below its class's floor is scored zero.

allow_remapping_by_area_matrix.description: Area-based class remapping (square, row-major, indexed by ObjectClassification label): whether a label may become another. Set all three matrices to enable remapping.

min_area_matrix.description: Smallest BEV area of each remapping [m^2].

max_area_matrix.description: Largest BEV area of each remapping [m^2].

enabled.description: Subscribe to the turn-indicator report for a model whose graph reads turn_indicators; false binds a constant and subscribes to nothing.

line_string_max_step_m.description: Largest spacing of the resampled points of a map line string [m].

velocity_smoothing_window.description: Trailing window of the trajectory velocity smoothing [points].

stopping_threshold.description: Speed below which a decelerating plan latches a stop [m/s].

min_probability.description: Probability a new turn-indicator state must lead with.

confirm_cycles.description: Consecutive cycles a new state must lead for.

hold_s.description: Least time between two changes of the command [s].

enable_stop.description: Publish the stop the trajectory plans as a planning factor.

enable_slowdown.description: Publish the slow-down the trajectory plans as a planning factor.

stop_velocity_threshold.description: A point at or below this speed is a stop [m/s].

stop_keep_duration_threshold.description: A stop must hold this long to be reported [s].

slowdown_accel_threshold.description: A point decelerating harder than this is part of a slow-down [m/s^2].
